class.name: ReflectionUtils
class.brief_description: Read-only views of GDScript methods and properties.
class.description: Maps [MethodInfo] and [PropertyInfo] from [method GDScript.get_script_method_list], [method GDScript.get_script_property_list], and [method GDScript.get_method_info] into [ScriptInfo], [VariableInfo], [FunctionInfo], and [ParameterInfo]. Those Godot records stay dictionaries. This class does not run when a script loads. [method GDScript.get_script_property_list] does not include static variables. [method get_variable_info] still returns one when the script stores a static [PropertyInfo] under that name.

method.name: get_function_info
method.description: Returns the [FunctionInfo] for [param name], searching [param script] and its GDScript bases, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_function_list
method.description: Returns a [FunctionInfo] for each method on [param script] and its GDScript bases. [member FunctionInfo.gdscript] is the script that declares the method.

method.name: get_parameter_info
method.description: Returns the [ParameterInfo] for one argument of [param function], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_parameter_list
method.description: Returns a [ParameterInfo] for each argument of [param function], in declaration order. Empty when the function is missing.

method.name: get_variable_info
method.description: Returns the [VariableInfo] for [param name], searching [param script] and its GDScript bases, or [code]null[/code]. Includes a static variable stored on that script.

method.name: get_variable_list
method.description: Returns a [VariableInfo] for each property and static variable on [param script] and its GDScript bases. [member VariableInfo.gdscript] is the script that declares the variable.
